about.title: Paramount Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Paramount's traffic runs through a compact grid where Rosecrans Avenue, Alondra Boulevard, Garfield Avenue, and Downey Avenue carry heavy local and pass-through traffic every day. Public records show 217 injury collisions in the most recent final year, with 299 people injured and 4 lives lost — and reported crashes tend to cluster on Friday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m., when commuters, delivery vehicles, and school traffic overlap. If you were hurt in one of these collisions, the days right after matter: photos fade, skid marks get repaved, and witnesses move on. LawProactive doesn't practice law — we're a free service that connects injured Paramount residents with an independent personal injury attorney who can evaluate what happened, handle communication with insurers, and help you understand your options. There's no obligation to move forward, and no fee unless your case results in a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Paramount Residents Turn to LawProactive

items.title: California's Clock Is Already Running
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a claim, but if a government vehicle or agency is involved, that window can shrink to as little as six months. Connecting with an attorney early helps make sure that deadline isn't missed.

items.title: Comparative Fault Won't Automatically Sink Your Claim
items.desc: California allows recovery even if you're partly at fault, with your compensation adjusted to reflect your share of responsibility. An attorney can help make sure fault is assessed fairly rather than left to the other driver's insurer.

items.title: No Recorded Statement Without Guidance
items.desc: Insurance adjusters often ask for a recorded statement quickly after a crash — before you know the full extent of your injuries. An independent attorney can advise you on what to say and what to hold off on until you're better informed.

items.question: I was hurt near Rosecrans and Alondra during rush hour — does that change my claim?
items.answer: Location and timing don't change your legal rights, but they can matter for evidence, like nearby traffic cameras or witnesses who were also stuck in that Friday afternoon congestion. An attorney can help track down that kind of supporting information before it disappears. LawProactive can connect you with someone who handles this locally.

items.question: What if the other driver's insurer wants my statement right away?
items.answer: You're not obligated to give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company, and doing so early can sometimes be used against you later. It's generally wise to speak with an attorney first. LawProactive can connect you with one at no cost before you respond to any insurer.

items.question: How much of my settlement would go to attorney fees?
items.answer: Attorneys in LawProactive's network work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation. The exact percentage is discussed and agreed upon directly with the attorney before any work begins.
